name: Ludo Dosti: Play with Friends
subtitle: Classic board game online
promotionalText: The classic Ludo board game in red, green, yellow and blue. Invite friends with a link, play an online match, or pass one phone around the family.
description:
Ludo Dosti is the classic Ludo board game, made simple and friendly.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Online match: find an opponent in seconds.
• Play with friends: create a room and share the invitation link; friends join from the app or the website.
• One device: two to four players pass the phone around, or practise against the computer.

CLASSIC RULES
• Roll a 6 to bring a pawn out.
• A 6 gives another roll; three 6s in a row lose the turn.
• Land on an opponent to send them home and earn a bonus roll. Star cells are safe.
• Bring all four pawns to the centre first to win.

FAIR DICE
In online games the server commits to every roll before it happens and your device adds its own random number, so each roll can be checked under "Verify roll". Dice are never adjusted.

NO SIGN-UP, NO TRACKING
No account and no tracking. Just choose a display name and play.

DAILY COINS
Collect free coins every day and spend them on new boards, pawns and dice in Persian craft styles: wood, turquoise, tile, khatam, copper and gold. Want more? Watch an optional ad in the shop. Coins are never sold and only change the look; the dice stay fair.

Persian and English, with the familiar four colours and a large, easy-to-tap board.

review.notes:
No login is needed.

Home screen modes:
1) "Quick online game" (online match): the device joins the server's queue for a few seconds. If another player is searching at the same time, both are paired on the server (server-rolled, verifiable dice). If nobody is searching, the opponent is the built-in computer player shown with a random first name.
2) "Play with friends": tap "Create room", then "Share invitation". A second device (or the website https://mench.espadna.com) opens the link, enters a display name and joins; the host taps "Start game".
3) "Offline with friends or the bot": 2-4 local players, optionally against the computer (Settings).

The menu (top corner of the home screen) has the display name, language (Persian/English), how to play, the privacy policy and support links. Coins come from a daily reward, won games and optional rewarded ads in the Shop (shown only when the player taps "Watch an ad"); they buy board, pawn and dice designs and cannot be bought. The app has no chat, purchases or tracking and never asks for tracking permission. Without internet the online modes say so and only the offline game opens.
